about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Christian D. Menefee

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
sentences: This bill would help over 50,000 veterans in this country, and that is more money that they can spend on gas, groceries, and utilities, as this President has driven up costs with the war in Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I urge them to use that same argument for the Iran war, where we could be saving taxpayers' money and saving lives for our troops.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote today in favor of the Major Richard Star Act, and I am proud to have been one of the signatories to the discharge petition that forced this vote today because Republicans would not set it on the floor.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote for the Major Richard Star Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
statements.title: PROPOSING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES TO REQUIRE THAT THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES BE COMPOSED OF NINE JUSTICES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to this constitutional amendment that would lock the number of Supreme Court Justices at nine.
When President Trump starts a war in Iran, they refuse to pass a War Powers Resolution.
Now I am hearing an argument that we should lock the number at nine because that is what the Supreme Court wants, but that is not how the Constitution works.
The Constitution says that it is Congress that has the power to set the size of the Supreme Court.

Because they want to lock in this Supreme Court--this Supreme Court that has gutted voting rights, this Supreme Court that has taken away a woman's right to choose, and this Supreme Court where Justices take secret gifts and private jets and answer to absolutely nobody.
Americans are asking for something in the Supreme Court.
They want to see a Supreme Court that reflects the American people and not just the few, a small group of elites.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
statements.title: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, President Trump has spent more than a year promising that he would make life more affordable for Americans, but when he took office, instead of lowering grocery bills, rent, and healthcare costs, he went straight after diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Last month, a Federal judge ruled that Houston's minority and women- owned business enterprise program is unconstitutional for considering race when awarding city contracts because of President Trump's anti-DEI policies.
Republicans call DEI policies handouts and reverse discrimination, but we know that is not true.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAKE CARE OF AMERICA'S VETERANS ACT
statements.title: TAKE CARE OF AMERICA'S VETERANS ACT
sentences: Yet, if we are pinching pennies, let's tell the President to end his war in Iran, which has cost taxpayers billions and billions of dollars.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose H.R. 9237, which, if we are being clear, cuts veterans' benefits.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote against H.R. 9237.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING FOR WOMEN'S FREEDOMS
statements.title: FIGHTING FOR WOMEN'S FREEDOMS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, last week marked 4 years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and ripped away the constitutional right women had relied on for nearly 50 years.
In Texas, Republican politicians rushed to impose some of the most extreme abortion bans in the entire country.
Since Dobbs and Texas' total abortion ban, infant deaths in Texas jumped from 1,985 to 2,240 in a single year.
If those pushing these abortion bans truly cared about life, they would be fighting for affordable childcare, paid family leave, and better maternal healthcare.

On this anniversary, I hope that we all stay committed to fighting so that every single woman in this country can get their freedom and their right to an abortion back in this country. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5408, FASTER LABOR CONTRACTS ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5408, FASTER LABOR CONTRACTS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Faster Labor Contracts Act.

Mr. Speaker, I am just astonished to hear my colleagues on the other side of the aisle argue that this bill was rushed when they failed to take it up in committee, when we all know that under their leadership, the committee has focused on attacking unions and attacking trans kids.
Maybe if they focused more on education and workforce, we would see more bills like this come to the floor through a proper process that actually helps unions.
Right now, when those workers vote to form a union, what the law requires is that the employer bargain in good faith.
That is why the average time between a union vote and the first contract is over a year, a year when the bosses hold all of the cards.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill, and I urge my colleagues across the aisle to spend better time when they are managing their committees.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
sentences: This bill would require the government to run every single financial aid application through a fraud detection algorithm, and if you get flagged, the college that you have been admitted to cannot release a single dollar until you jump through hoops to prove who you are.
For a kid who does not know the system, that could mean a missed enrollment deadline.
Study after study on identification verification programs and fraud detection algorithms consistently show a higher false positive for Black and Hispanic users.
I bet they are going to be lower income, those experiencing homelessness, eligible noncitizens, working adults who cannot afford to take a day off to drive to the financial aid office.

If even one student in this country is denied financial aid wrongly because this algorithm did not work out properly because we rushed the process and didn't have accuracy standards, that would be an absolute travesty to the people that we serve.
Mr. Speaker, I rise to oppose H.R. 7892, the so-called No Aid for Ghost Students Act.
Mr. Speaker, I oppose this bill, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT TRANS LIVES
statements.title: PROTECT TRANS LIVES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, June is Pride Month, a month celebrating the contributions of the LGBTQ community, but it also must be a month of speaking hard truths.
Over half of Texas victims are Black transgender women.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFE FIREARM STORAGE
statements.title: SAFE FIREARM STORAGE
sentences: Safe firearm storage is one of the simplest and most effective ways to reduce gun violence, suicides, accidental deaths, and having stolen weapons end up in the hands of people who should not have them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBL
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of this resolution to bring an end to the President's war in Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
statements.title: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
sentences: The Supreme Court opened the door, and Republican officials throughout the South are running straight through it.
The right to choose our own Representatives is sacred and something our ancestors have fought and bled for, and we will not let it be stripped from us community by community or ZIP code by ZIP code.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
statements.title: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
sentences: It would even cut childcare, ignoring the realities families face.
As a father of two, I know how costly childcare is, and I am troubled by leaders who would make it harder, not easier, for parents to work and raise their children.
The President's policies have raised costs, worsened the affordability crisis, undermined access to healthcare, and delivered tax breaks for billionaires while working families fall further behind.
Millions of people risk losing vital care and financial security while a small number of billionaires see their wealth grow.
Think about that: Families are going without care so that the rich can get richer.
We are the wealthiest nation on Earth.
Our budget can and must afford investments in childcare and healthcare and support for our seniors while managing our finances responsibly.
What we cannot afford are priorities that put the richest first and leave working families behind.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose President Trump's budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOREIGN EMISSIONS AND NONATTAINMENT CLARIFICATION FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY ACT
statements.title: FOREIGN EMISSIONS AND NONATTAINMENT CLARIFICATION FOR ECONOMIC STABILITY ACT
sentences: They couldn't say yes to that because this bill was never about clean air.

This body lets pollution run rampant as our communities see poison in the wind that blows and wonder ``Where did all the blue skies go?'' We should be standing up to make sure that every single person in our communities has clean land, clean air, and clean water, regardless of their ZIP Code or socioeconomic status.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition of the FENCES Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on the FENCES Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
statements.title: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
sentences: We owe it to our communities to make sure they have access to clean air, clean land, and clean water, regardless of where in this country they live.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to the so- called RED Tape Act.

Before I came to Congress, I stood up to the Trump administration in court when they tried to roll back environmental protections, and I plan to do the exact same thing in the Halls of Congress, as well.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote ``no'' on this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
statements.title: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
sentences: We are going to be all right, but not by accident and not without work.

statements.title: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BETRAYAL OF TRUST
statements.title: BETRAYAL OF TRUST
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am not an economist, but I understand that the U.S. war with Iran has shaken global markets, driven oil prices up more than 40 percent, and is even raising fears of a worldwide recession, impacting flights and the cost of goods.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
statements.title: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
sentences: I am not an economist, but I do know this: The U.S. war with Iran has rattled global markets, driven up oil prices more than 40 percent, and sparked real fears of a worldwide recession.
